mono.purpose: Commands, code, file paths, provider IDs, and generations.

components.name: Documentation Navigation
components.description: Compact access to the guide, API, React integration, and package registry.
components.html: GuidePatch APIReactnpm ↗
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; font: 650 14px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #10233f; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #075ff7; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Runnable commands and source examples within technical documents.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; padding: 20px 24px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid rgba(127,172,233,.18); border-radius: 10px; color: #eef5ff; background: #0b1f3a; font: 460 14px/1.55 'Source Code Pro', monospace; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reference Table
components.description: Task routing, compatibility data, and runtime guarantees.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(20,59,112,.16); border-radius: 8px; color: #10233f; font: 460 16px/1.5 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20,59,112,.16); text-align: left; } .ds-table th { color: #40536d; background: #edf3fc; } .ds-table a { color: #075ff7; text-underline-offset: .18em; } .ds-table a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,95,247,.56); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A precise technical reference on cool paper. The standard documentation shell, clear typography, cobalt links, command blocks, and compact tables keep runtime Patch behavior calm and inspectable.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks links, focus, and brand identity; neutral surfaces carry everything else.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Rule
rules.body: Technical nouns and transformation terms wrap between words, never inside them.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from type, spacing, and one-pixel boundaries rather than elevation.

dos: Put requirements and runnable commands first on the index.
Keep English and Simplified Chinese navigation equivalent.
Keep tables and code independently scrollable on mobile.
donts: Do not use a marketing Hero on the documentation index.
Do not add decorative motion or background geometry.
Do not turn each concept into a rounded card.
Do not introduce dashboard or game-mod styling.
